# Kevala Home — WB RERA Check

> Free Progressive Web App to verify the RERA registration status of any real estate project in West Bengal. No login, no ads, works offline. Official data from rera.wb.gov.in.

WB RERA Check is a free tool by Kevala Home that lets property buyers and sellers instantly verify whether a West Bengal real estate project is RERA-registered and currently active, revoked, or expired — before paying any booking advance. The app covers 4,300+ projects sourced from the official West Bengal RERA portal and is installable as a PWA on Android and iOS.

## Core Function

- [WB RERA Check](https://wbrera.kevalahome.com/): Search 4,300+ WB RERA registered projects by project name, promoter name, or RERA registration number. Returns live active / revoked / expired status, registration and completion dates, promoter details, district, project type, unit count, amenities, and a link to the official RERA certificate PDF.

## Key Pages & Features

- [Search](https://wbrera.kevalahome.com/): Main search interface. Supports free-text search, filter by Active or Revoked status, quick-search chips for common developers, and search history. Results load from a cached JSON dataset served via GitHub — works fully offline after first visit.
- [Browse All RERA Projects](https://wbrera.kevalahome.com/projects/index.html): Full index of all WB RERA registered projects, browseable without search.
- [Install Guide](https://wbrera.kevalahome.com/#guide): Step-by-step instructions to install the app on Android (Chrome), iPhone/iPad (Safari), and Desktop (Chrome/Edge). Installing enables full-screen mode and offline access.
- [Saved Projects](https://wbrera.kevalahome.com/#saved): Bookmark projects locally on-device for quick re-access. No account required — stored in the browser.
- [Buyer Safety Checklist](https://wbrera.kevalahome.com/#checklist): A 10-point checklist of things to verify before paying a booking advance — RERA status, building plan sanction, land title, escrow account, sale agreement clauses, bank approval, utility connections, and developer track record.

## Data

- Source: Official West Bengal RERA portal (rera.wb.gov.in)
- Dataset: approved.json (active projects), rejected.json (revoked projects), certificates.json (certificate metadata), projects_cleaned.json (enriched project details including promoter address, amenities, Google Maps URL, source URL, certificate PDF link)
- Updates: Dataset is periodically refreshed from the official portal and served via GitHub raw content
- Coverage: 4,300+ projects across all districts of West Bengal

## About

- [About](https://wbrera.kevalahome.com/#about): Tool overview, data coverage stats, links to the official WB RERA portal and Kevala Home main site
- [Main Site](https://kevalahome.com/): Kevala Home homepage — links to all three free tools
- Contact: info@kevalahome.com

## Technical Notes

Built as a single-page PWA (Progressive Web App). All project data is fetched from GitHub-hosted JSON files and cached via a service worker for offline use. No backend server, no user data collected, no login required. The app uses stale-while-revalidate caching — searches work even without an internet connection using the last-fetched dataset.

## What This Tool Does Not Do

- It does not provide legal advice or make recommendations on whether to buy a property
- It does not replace verification on the official WB RERA portal (rera.wb.gov.in) before making a financial decision
- It does not cover RERA registrations outside West Bengal
- It does not show current property prices or availability
